programme.title: Awara Paagal Deewana

programme.title: Love Sex Aur Dhoka
programme.desc: An Indian anthology film that tells three separate but interconnected stories revolving around the themes of love, sex, and betrayal. It explores the dark side of relationships and the impact of technology on modern romance.
